own_example: In one fixed linear RGB space, two retained fragments cover the same sample over opaque black: red alpha1/4 and cyan alpha3/4. Red then cyan gives (1/16,3/4,3/4); reversed gives (1/4,9/16,9/16), both final alpha1.
limits: No optimizer, renderer, image or performance execution.
List order is explicitly assumed to determine this example composition, without later sorting or rejection.
No claim the fixed library actually swaps these two triangles or officially prohibits all transparent optimization.
Triangle order, per-triangle winding and vertex-storage numbering are distinguished.
No general sorting, order-independent transparency or arbitrary-shader equivalence guarantee.
